title: objectclassification: Garbage classification and robotic selection using convolutional neural networks
description:
Computer vision system for garbage classification and selection with a robotic arm. Combines convolutional neural network models for object recognition with inverse kinematics for manipulation, and includes a graphical interface for operation and real-time video inference.

Developed for teaching and applied research in the Mechatronics Engineering program at Universidad Militar Nueva Granada. Includes deployment documentation in Spanish aimed at students new to Python and version control.
